title: A Rising Power
text: Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Gain 1 additional Influence whenever you win a Diplomacy conflict.

title: Defense in Depth
text: Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: When an opponent targets your character with a conflict, you may rotate this Agenda to add 2 to your defense total.

title: Higher Calling
text: Major Agenda. Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Gain 1 Influence at the start of each round.

title: Imperialism
text: Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Your Military conflicts reward 1 additional Influence when won.

title: Infiltrate and Exploit
text: Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Gain 1 Influence whenever an opponent plays an Event card.

title: Knowledge is Power
text: Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Once per round, draw 1 extra card.

title: Maintain the Peace
text: Major Agenda. Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Gain 2 Influence instead of 1 when you successfully stop a Military conflict as a defender.

title: Meddling with Others
text: Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: When an opponent wins a conflict by more than 3, gain 1 Influence.

title: Peace In Our Time
text: Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Gain 1 Influence for each round in which no Military conflict occurs.

title: Power Politics
text: Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: When you play an Event card during another player's turn, gain 1 Influence.

title: Seizing Advantage
text: Major Agenda. Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: When any player is eliminated from a conflict, gain 1 Influence.

title: Strength in Adversity
text: Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Gain 1 Influence whenever one of your characters is damaged in a conflict.

title: Support of the Mighty
text: Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: When you support another player's conflict, gain 1 Influence if that player wins.

title: The Hope of Peace
text: Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Gain 1 Influence at the end of any round in which no conflict was lost by you.

title: Total War
text: Win Condition: Have strictly more total Military than every other player. Ongoing: Your fleets gain +1 Military. You may not play Diplomacy conflict cards.

title: Growth in Chaos
text: Centauri only. Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Gain 1 Influence whenever any player loses an Intrigue conflict.

title: Rise of the Republic
text: Centauri only. Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Gain 1 Influence for each Centauri Location card you have in play.

text: Human only. Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: When you support another player's Diplomacy conflict and they win, gain 2 Influence.

title: Leading the Races
text: Human only. Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Gain 1 Influence whenever you initiate a conflict that another player joins as a supporter.

title: Forced Evolution
text: Major Agenda. Win Condition: Have the most characters in your Inner Circle. Ongoing: Characters you recruit cost 1 less Influence.

title: Order Above All
text: Major Agenda. Win Condition: Have more total Military strength than any other player. Ongoing: Your fleets gain +1 Military.

title: Finish the War

title: Servants of Order

title: Never Again
text: Narn only. Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Gain 2 Influence whenever you win a Military conflict against the Centauri player.

title: Revenge
text: Narn only. Win Condition: Reach 20 Influence. Ongoing: Once per round, you may spend 1 Influence to add 2 to your Military conflict total against one opponent.

title: Sabotage
text: Intrigue conflict. Winner gains 2 Influence. Loser must rotate one fleet.

text: Intrigue conflict. Winner gains 2 Influence. Loser loses 1 Influence per Location card they have in play.

title: Technological Espionage
text: Intrigue conflict. Winner gains 1 Influence and may copy one Enhancement effect from loser's play area until end of round.

text: Military conflict. Winner gains 2 Influence and may play a Location card from hand for free.

text: Military conflict. Winner gains 2 Influence. May use Leadership stat instead of Military.

title: Covert Allies

title: Latent Telepath

title: Overworked

title: Personal Protection
text: Attach to a Character. That character cannot be targeted by Intrigue conflicts.

title: Psi Bodyguard
text: Attach to a Character. That character gains +2 Psi and cannot be targeted by Intrigue conflicts while this Enhancement is attached.

title: Pulling Strings
text: Attach to a Character. That character gains +1 to all stats.

title: Security Training
text: Attach to a Character. That character gains +2 Intrigue and +1 Leadership.

title: Shunned

title: Vorlon Enhancement
text: Attach to a Character. That character gains +2 to all stats and the ability to participate in any conflict type.

title: Working Relationship

title: Assault Troops
text: Faction Enhancement. All your fleets gain +1 Military.

title: Draft

title: Fixed in Their Ways

title: Isolationism

title: Judgment by Success
text: Faction Enhancement. Gain 1 Influence whenever you win two or more conflicts in the same round.

title: Mines
text: Faction Enhancement. Opponents' fleets that attack you take 1 damage (fleet is rotated after the conflict).

title: Secondary Control
text: Faction Enhancement. You may have two Agendas in play simultaneously (normally limited to one).

title: Vital Interests
text: Faction Enhancement. Once per round, you may spend 2 Influence to force all other players to support or oppose a conflict you initiate.

title: Censure
text: Attach to an opponent's Fleet. That fleet's Military value is reduced by 2 (minimum 1).

title: Mass Drivers
text: Attach to a Fleet. That fleet gains +3 Military. If you win a Military conflict with this fleet, the loser also loses 1 additional Influence.

title: Commerce Raiding
text: Global Enhancement. At the start of each round, each player with no Location cards in play loses 1 Influence.

title: Armed Resistance
text: Attach to a Location card. That Location gains +2 Military defense. Opponents targeting this Location lose 1 Influence even if they win.

title: Exploitation
text: Attach to a Location card. That Location provides 1 extra Influence per round.

title: Fleet Support Base
text: Attach to a Location card. One fleet associated with this Location gains +2 Military while this card is in play.

title: Planetary Defenses
text: Attach to a Location card. Opponents must win a Military conflict to take control of this Location.

title: Salvage Yard
text: Attach to a Location card. Once per round, you may take a Fleet card from your discard pile and put it into play at half its Military value (rounded down).

title: Triluminary
text: Minbari Character only. That character gains +2 Psi and +2 Diplomacy. Minbari only.

title: Stealth Technology
text: Minbari Fleet only. That fleet gains +3 Military and cannot be targeted by fleet-targeting Enhancement cards.

title: Crystal Cities
text: Minbari Location only. That Location provides 2 Influence per round instead of 1.

title: Book of G'Quan
text: Narn Character only. That character gains +2 Intrigue and +2 Leadership.

title: Energy Mines
text: Narn Fleet only. That fleet gains +2 Military. Opponents' fleets that attack this fleet take 1 extra damage.

title: A Good Bluff
text: Play during any conflict. Add 3 to your conflict total. Discard after use.

title: Accident
text: Play during any conflict. One opposing character of your choice is rotated immediately.

title: Affirm Alliance
text: Play any time. Gain 1 Influence. You and one other player agree not to attack each other this round.

title: Armistice
text: Play before a conflict resolves. Cancel one Military conflict. No Aftermath cards may be played.

title: Avert Incident
text: Play when targeted by an Intrigue conflict. Add 2 to your defense total.

title: Balance
text: Play any time. All players gain 1 Influence. No conflicts may be initiated this round after this card is played.

title: Carpe Diem
text: Play during your Action Phase. Take one additional action this round.

title: Change of Plans
text: Play before a conflict is initiated. Change the conflict type to a different type of your choice.

title: Changing Opinion
text: Play any time. Move one player from supporting to opposing (or vice versa) in an active conflict.

title: Chaos Reigns
text: Play any time. All players must discard one card at random.

title: Chrysalis
text: Minbari only. Play during your Action Phase. Replace Delenn with Delenn Transformed in your Ambassador Zone if she is currently in play. Draw 2 cards.

title: Competing Interests
text: Play before a conflict. One player who is supporting an opponent's conflict must switch to opposing instead, or withdraw from the conflict.

title: Concentrated Effort
text: Play before you initiate a conflict. Gain +3 to that conflict's total.

title: Conflicting Desires
text: Play any time. Choose two players. They must each either support or oppose the current active conflict.

title: Conflicting Loyalties
text: Play any time. Each player must discard one card or rotate one of their Inner Circle characters.

title: Confusion in Chaos
text: Play any time. All players shuffle their hands into their draw piles and draw the same number of cards.

title: Contact with Shadows
text: Play any time. Draw 2 cards. If you have Morden in play, draw 3 cards instead.

title: Contact with Vorlons
text: Play any time. Draw 2 cards from your draw pile.

title: Coordinated Fire
text: Play during a Military conflict you are involved in. Add 2 to your fleet Military total for each fleet you have committed to this conflict.

title: Cut Supply Lines
text: Play before a Military conflict. One opposing fleet's Military value is halved (rounded down) for this conflict.

title: Decisive Tactics
text: Play before a conflict resolves. The winner gains 1 extra Influence and the loser loses 1 Influence.

title: Declaration of War
text: Play at the start of a round. For this round, all Military conflicts reward 1 extra Influence.

title: Defame Ambassador
text: Play any time. One opponent's ambassador loses 2 Diplomacy until the end of the round.

title: Destiny Fulfilled
text: Play any time. Gain 2 Influence. You may not initiate conflicts this round.

title: Diplomatic Blunder
text: Play after an opponent wins a Diplomacy conflict. That player loses 1 Influence.

title: Diplomatic Immunity
text: Play when your ambassador is targeted in a conflict. Your ambassador cannot be targeted this round.

title: Early Warning
text: Play when an opponent initiates a conflict against you. You may look at their hand before the conflict resolves.

title: Emergency Military Aid
text: Play during a Military conflict. Bring one fleet from your hand into play immediately for this conflict only.

title: Exploration
text: Play any time. Search your draw pile for a Location card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your draw pile.

title: Fleets on the Border
text: Play at the start of a round. All players' fleets are considered committed to border patrol; fleets cannot be rotated for effects this round.

title: For My People
text: Play any time. One of your faction characters who is in Supporting Role immediately moves to Inner Circle for free.

title: For the Common Good
text: Play any time. All players gain 1 Influence.

title: For the Good of All
text: Play any time. Gain 1 Influence for each other player who did not win a conflict this round.

title: Forces Collide
text: Play during a Military conflict. All fleets in play must immediately participate in this conflict. No Aftermath cards may be played afterward.

title: Hidden Knowledge
text: Play any time. Look at one opponent's hand. You may discard one card from it.

title: Hire Raiders
text: Play during a Military conflict. Add 2 to your Military total. Discard this card.

title: Hour of the Wolf
text: Play at the start of a round. For this round, all conflicts cost 1 more Influence to initiate.

title: Internal Strife
text: Play any time. One opponent must rotate one of their Inner Circle characters.

title: Intrigues Mature
text: Play any time. Draw 2 cards.

title: Knowledge of Shadows
text: Play any time. Look at one opponent's entire hand. If they have Morden, gain 1 Influence.

title: Knowledge of the Soul
text: Play any time. Search your draw pile for any one card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your draw pile.

title: Lack of Subtlety
text: Play after an opponent plays an Event card. Cancel that card's effect.

title: Level the Playing Field 3+9
text: Play any time. The player with the most Influence gives 3 Influence to the player with the least. (Errata: triggering condition is a spread of 9 or more Influence between highest and lowest.)

title: Liquidating Assets
text: Play any time. Discard up to 3 cards from your hand. Gain 1 Influence for each card discarded.

title: Lockdown
text: Play at start of round. No player may recruit characters or play Enhancements this round.

title: Long Term Investment
text: Play any time. Pay 2 Influence now; gain 4 Influence at the start of your next turn.

title: Medical Assistance
text: Play any time. Heal one face-down character in your Inner Circle.

title: Meditation
text: Play any time. Draw 3 cards, then discard 2.

title: Merchandising B5
text: Play any time. Gain 1 Influence.

title: Moral Quandary
text: Play any time. One opponent must choose: discard 1 card or lose 1 Influence.

title: News of Galactic Import
text: Play any time. All players draw 1 card.

title: Not Meant to Be
text: Play after a conflict resolves. Negate the winner's Influence gain from that conflict.

title: Political Realignment
text: Play any time. One player must move one of their Inner Circle characters to Supporting Role. That player gains 1 Influence.

title: Popular Support
text: Play any time. Gain 2 Influence if you currently have the fewest Influence points among all players.

title: Prolonged Talks
text: Play before a Diplomacy conflict. That conflict's Influence reward is doubled. All participants must commit their ambassador.

title: Rally to the Cause
text: Play when supporting another player's conflict. Add 2 to the total for the side you are supporting.

title: Ramming
text: Play during a Military conflict. Sacrifice one of your fleets to deal 3 damage to an opposing fleet (reduce that fleet's Military by 3 for this conflict).

title: Recalled to Service
text: Play any time. Return one fleet from your discard pile to play.

title: Sanctions
text: Play any time. One opponent loses 1 Influence for each Location card you have in play.

title: Secret Strike
text: Play before a conflict. You initiate a Military conflict without revealing which fleet you are using until resolution.

title: Secret Vorlon Aid
text: Play any time. Gain 2 Influence. If Kosh Naranek is in your Inner Circle, gain 3 Influence instead.

title: Seduction
text: Play any time. One opponent's Inner Circle character temporarily joins your side for one conflict this round.

title: Self Doubt
text: Play during any conflict. One opposing character loses 2 from their primary stat for this conflict.

title: Shadow Strike
text: Play during a conflict. Add 4 to your total. Your characters cannot be healed after this conflict if you lose.

title: Short Term Goals
text: Play any time. Gain 1 Influence immediately.

title: Short Term Investment
text: Play any time. Pay 1 Influence; gain 2 Influence at the start of next round.

title: Sneak Attack
text: Play before a conflict. The opponent cannot play Event cards in response to this conflict.

title: Sortie
text: Play during a Military conflict. Your fleets gain +1 Military for each fleet you have committed to this conflict.

title: Special Ops
text: Play before an Intrigue conflict. Add 3 to your Intrigue total.

title: Strafing Run
text: Play during a Military conflict. The loser's highest Military fleet is rotated.

title: Strategic Reassignment
text: Play any time. Move one character from your Supporting Role to Inner Circle or vice versa for free.

title: Subliminal Influence
text: Play any time. One opponent must support your next conflict, providing their full Psi stat value.

title: Support Babylon 5
text: Play any time. Gain 1 Influence. One Enhancement card on Babylon 5 is rotated.

title: The Opposition Rises
text: Play during a conflict. All players not currently involved must either support or oppose this conflict.

title: The Price of Power
text: Play any time. The player with the most Influence loses 2 Influence. If there is a tie, each tied player loses 1 Influence.

title: Trade Windfall
text: Play any time. Gain 1 Influence for each Location card you have in play.

title: Underworld Connections
text: Play any time. Draw 2 cards. If N'Grath is in your Inner Circle, draw 3 instead.

title: Universe Today Feature
text: Play any time. Reveal your hand. Gain 1 Influence for each Agenda card revealed.

title: Unrecognized Data
text: Play any time. Look at the top 3 cards of any player's draw pile. Leave them in any order.

title: Victory in My Grasp
text: Play when you are winning a conflict. Gain 1 extra Influence from that conflict.

title: Vorlon Rescue
text: Play when one of your Inner Circle characters would be discarded. That character is moved to Supporting Role instead of discarded.

title: War by Popular Decree
text: Play at start of round. All players must initiate or join a Military conflict this round or lose 1 Influence.

title: What Do You Want?
text: Play any time. One opponent must discard one card of your choice (you name the type: Character, Fleet, etc.).

title: Who Are You?
text: Play any time. One opponent must reveal their entire hand to all players.

title: You Are Not Ready
text: Play when an opponent initiates a conflict against you. That conflict is cancelled; no Aftermath cards may be played.

title: You Know My Reputation
text: Play before initiating a conflict. Add 2 to your total. The opponent may not recruit backup characters.

title: Approval of the Grey
text: Minbari only. Play after winning any conflict. Gain 1 Influence and heal one face-down character.

title: Assigning Blame
text: Play after losing any conflict. One opponent loses 1 Influence.

title: Battle Tested
text: Play after participating in a Military conflict. One of your characters gains +1 Leadership permanently.

title: Blood Oath
text: Play after losing any conflict. Declare a Blood Oath against the winner; your conflicts against them gain +2 for the rest of the game.

title: Casualty Reports
text: Play after a Military conflict. Each player who participated must rotate one fleet. Gain 1 Influence.

title: Combat Experience
text: Play after participating in a Military conflict. Draw 1 card.

title: Crisis of Self
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a conflict. That opponent must discard 2 cards.

title: Despair
text: Play on an opponent after they lose any conflict. That opponent loses 2 Influence.

title: Develop Relationship
text: Play after any conflict. You and one other participant each draw 1 card.

title: Diplomatic Advantage
text: Play after winning a Diplomacy conflict. Gain 2 Influence and draw 1 card.

title: Disenchantment
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a Diplomacy conflict. That opponent loses 1 Influence.

title: Disgrace
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a Military conflict. That opponent's ambassador is rotated until healed.

title: Enrage
text: Play after losing a Diplomacy conflict. Immediately initiate a free Military conflict against the winner.

title: Exploit Opportunities
text: Play after winning an Intrigue conflict. Draw 2 cards.

title: Focus Your Efforts
text: Play after winning any conflict. Move one card from your discard pile to your hand.

title: Glory
text: Play after winning a Diplomacy or Military conflict. Gain 2 Influence.

title: Grievance
text: Play after winning any conflict. One opponent must discard 1 card.

title: Guilt
text: Play on an opponent after they win a Military conflict. That opponent loses 1 Influence.

title: Harvest Souls
text: Play after any conflict. Take 2 cards at random from the losing player's hand.

title: Hidden Agent
text: Play after winning an Intrigue conflict. Look at one opponent's hand and take 1 card of your choice.

title: Hunted
text: Play on an opponent after any Intrigue conflict. That opponent's highest-Intrigue character is damaged.

title: In the Line of Duty
text: Play after any conflict in which your ambassador participated. Heal your ambassador if damaged.

title: Inevitable Destiny
text: Play after any conflict. Gain 1 Influence for each character you had participating.

title: Intolerable Interference
text: Play after losing any conflict. Gain 1 Influence. The winner may not initiate a conflict against you next round.

title: It Will Be His Undoing
text: Play after losing any conflict. That opponent's ambassador loses 2 from all stats until end of round.

title: Lamentations
text: Play after losing any conflict. Heal one face-down character in your Inner Circle.

title: Learning Experience
text: Play after participating in an Intrigue conflict. Draw 1 card.

title: Left Vulnerable
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a Diplomacy conflict. That opponent's characters lose 1 Diplomacy until end of round.

title: Loss of Face
text: Play on an opponent after they lose any conflict. That opponent loses 1 Influence.

title: Martyr
text: Play after any conflict in which one of your characters was discarded. Gain 3 Influence.

title: Negotiated Surrender
text: Play after a Military conflict. The loser may keep one fleet from being rotated. Gain 1 Influence.

title: News of Defeat
text: Play after a Military conflict. The loser must discard 1 card.

title: Nightmares
text: Play on an opponent after they lose any conflict. That opponent must skip drawing a card at end of this round.

title: No Escape
text: Play after a Military conflict. The loser may not withdraw any fleets; all committed fleets are rotated.

title: Older but Wiser
text: Play after participating in a Diplomacy conflict. Draw 1 card.

title: Paying for Sins
text: Play on an opponent after they lose an Intrigue conflict. That opponent must rotate their highest-Intrigue character.

title: Personal Enemies
text: Play on an opponent after they lose any conflict. One of your characters gains +1 to all stats when opposing that player this round.

title: Personal Involvement
text: Play after losing any conflict. Draw 1 card.

title: Personal Sacrifice
text: Play after winning any conflict. Gain 1 Influence.

title: Protests
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a Diplomacy conflict. All other players gain 1 Influence.

title: Public Apology
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a Military conflict. That opponent loses 2 Influence.

title: Racial Hatred
text: Play on an opponent after they lose any conflict. All conflicts between you and that player gain +1 for the rest of the game.

title: Refugees
text: Play after winning a Military conflict. Gain 1 Influence for each Location card you have in play.

title: Renowned Victory
text: Play after winning a Military conflict. Gain 1 additional Influence. All your fleets gain +1 Military until end of round.

title: Repairing the Past
text: Play after winning any conflict. Heal one face-down character in your Inner Circle.

title: Rescue
text: Play after a Military conflict. Return one rotated fleet to unrotated state.

title: Retribution
text: Play after winning any conflict. The loser must rotate one of their Inner Circle characters.

title: Reverse Advances
text: Play after losing a Diplomacy or Intrigue conflict. Negate the winner's Influence gain.

title: Rise to Power
text: Play after winning a Military conflict. Gain 2 Influence.

title: Rivalry
text: Play after participating in a Diplomacy conflict. Gain 1 Influence if you were the initiator or if you supported the winner.

title: Secondary Experience
text: Play after any conflict in which you participated as a supporter and the initiator won. Gain 1 Influence.

title: Skeletons in the Closet
text: Play after any conflict. Look at the losing player's hand; you may discard 1 card from it.

title: Successful Manipulation
text: Play after winning an Intrigue conflict. Draw 2 cards.

title: Under Pressure
text: Play after losing an Intrigue conflict. Gain 1 Influence.

title: United Front
text: Play after winning a Diplomacy conflict. Gain 1 Influence and draw 1 card.

title: Vendetta
text: Play after losing any conflict. The winner's next conflict gain is reduced by 2.

title: War Hero
text: Play after winning a Military conflict. One of your characters gains +2 Leadership permanently.

title: Wear and Tear
text: Play after a Military conflict. All fleets that participated are rotated.

title: Wounded
text: Play on an opponent after they lose an Intrigue or Military conflict. One of their Inner Circle characters is damaged.

title: Commercial Telepaths
text: Rotate this Group and choose a Character not already affected by this Group. For as long as this Group stays rotated, that Character adds half its Psi (rounded up) to its Diplomacy.

title: Counterintelligence
text: Rotate this Group during any Intrigue conflict. Add 3 to your Intrigue total.

title: Damage Control Team
text: Rotate this Group after any Military conflict. Unrotate one of your fleets.

title: Diplomatic Corps
text: Rotate this Group during any Diplomacy conflict. Add 2 to your Diplomacy total.

title: Extended Contacts
text: Rotate this Group any time. Draw 1 card.

title: Government Opposition
text: Rotate this Group any time. One opponent loses 1 Influence.

title: Interstellar Corporation
text: At the start of each round, gain 1 Influence.

title: ISN
text: Rotate this Group any time. Force one opponent to reveal their hand to all players.

title: Military Cadre
text: Rotate this Group during any Military conflict. Add 2 to your Military total.

title: Military Telepaths
text: Rotate this Group during any Psi conflict. Add 3 to your Psi total.

title: Motivated Leaders
text: All your characters in Inner Circle gain +1 Leadership permanently. Discard after this effect triggers.

title: Observers
text: Rotate this Group after any conflict. Look at all players' hands simultaneously.

title: Rabble Rousers
text: Rotate this Group any time. One opponent must discard 1 card.

title: Ranger Strike Team
text: Rotate this Group during any Military or Intrigue conflict. Add 2 to your total.

title: Rangers Surveillance
text: Rotate this Group any time. Look at the top 3 cards of any player's draw pile and rearrange them.

title: Secret Police
text: Rotate this Group during any Intrigue conflict. Add 2 to your Intrigue total. If you win, the loser must also rotate one character.

title: Spin Doctors
text: Rotate this Group after any conflict. Change the perceived winner of a Diplomacy conflict for Influence gain purposes (you gain their Influence; they gain none).

title: War College
text: Rotate this Group during any Military conflict. Add 2 to your Military total.

title: Imperial Telepaths
text: Centauri only. Rotate this Group during any Psi conflict. Add 3 to your Psi total. If you win, the loser must discard 1 card.

title: Influential Lords
text: Centauri only. At the start of each round, gain 1 Influence if you have 3 or more Centauri characters in your Inner Circle.

title: Psi Corps Intelligence
text: Human only. Rotate this Group during any Intrigue or Psi conflict. Add 2 to your total.

title: Religious Caste
text: Minbari only. At the start of each round, if you have no damaged characters, gain 1 Influence.

title: Warrior Caste
text: Minbari only. While in play, all Minbari fleets gain +1 Military.

title: Wind Swords
text: Minbari only. Rotate this Group during any Military conflict. Add 3 to your Military total.

title: Narn Rabble
text: Narn only. Rotate this Group during any Diplomacy or Military conflict. Add 2 to your total.

title: Thenta Makur
text: Narn only. Rotate this Group during any Intrigue conflict. Add 4 to your Intrigue total.

title: Centauri Prime
text: Centauri homeworld. Centauri only. Provides 2 Influence per round. Cannot be seized by Military conflict.

title: Immolan V
text: Centauri colony world. Provides 1 Influence per round. Centauri Military conflicts defending this Location gain +1.

title: Ragesh III
text: Centauri agricultural colony. Provides 1 Influence per round.

title: Earth
text: Human homeworld. Human only. Provides 2 Influence per round. Cannot be seized by Military conflict.

title: Mars Colony
text: Human colony on Mars. Provides 1 Influence per round. Human Intrigue conflicts here gain +1.

title: Proxima III
text: Human colony. Provides 1 Influence per round. Human Military conflicts here gain +1.

title: Transfer Point Io
text: Neutral trading hub. Any faction may control this. Provides 1 Influence per round. Draw 1 extra card per round while controlling this.

title: Minbar
text: Minbari homeworld. Minbari only. Provides 2 Influence per round. Cannot be seized by Military conflict.

title: Minbari Protectorate
text: Minbari protected world. Provides 1 Influence per round. Minbari Diplomacy conflicts here gain +1.

title: Narn Homeworld
text: Narn homeworld. Narn only. Provides 2 Influence per round. Cannot be seized by Military conflict.

title: Quadrant 14
text: Narn border territory. Provides 1 Influence per round. Narn Military conflicts here gain +2.

title: Quadrant 37
text: Narn outer territory. Provides 1 Influence per round.

title: Sleeping Z'ha'dum
text: Shadow homeworld. Any faction. Provides 2 Influence per round. While in play, all Intrigue conflicts gain +1. Cannot be seized by Diplomacy conflicts.
